title: 2-bed apartment in Lozenets, near South Park
overview: 78 m2 two-bedroom in Sofia's most consistently liquid rental district, 10 min walk to South Park and the metro. 2019 building, low service charge. Strong long-let demand from tech professionals (Lozenets sits next to the office cluster on Cherni Vrah Blvd).
risks: BGN/EUR peg transition to euro adoption (Jan 2026) settled, but watch pricing in EUR
Service charge increases in managed buildings

short_let.note: Lozenets is primarily a long-let district; short-let demand is moderate (business travellers).

title: 1-bed near Vitosha Blvd / NDK
overview: 52 m2 one-bedroom two blocks from Vitosha Boulevard, the city's prime pedestrian artery. Older brick building (1980s) with renovated interior. Works for long lets and is one of the few central micro-locations where short lets also clear well.
highlights: Dual strategy: long let or short let
risks: Short-let regulation tightening in central Sofia

short_let.note: Vitosha Blvd / NDK is the strongest short-let micro-location in Sofia.

title: New-build 2-bed in Mladost 4, business park corridor
overview: 85 m2 off-plan completion Q4 2026 next to Business Park Sofia. Developer pricing still below Lozenets. The strongest pure-yield play of the three Sofia entries thanks to corporate tenant demand and a lower entry price per m2.
highlights: Highest projected gross yield in Sofia set
risks: Off-plan completion risk - use staged payments via lawyer
Mladost has heavy new supply pipeline

short_let.note: Business-park corridor: weekday corporate stays, weak weekends.

title: Renovated 2-bed in Koukaki, Acropolis foothills
overview: 68 m2 fully renovated apartment in Koukaki, repeatedly ranked among Europe's strongest short-let micro-markets and equally liquid for long lets to professionals. 8 min walk to the Acropolis Museum and metro.
risks: New short-let licence restrictions in central Athens (registration freeze zones)
ENFIA and municipal fees rising with zone values

short_let.note: Koukaki sits in central Athens District 1 where NEW short-let (AMA) registrations are frozen until 31 Dec 2026 - a new buyer cannot legally short-let. Modelled as long let only.

title: Value-add 3-bed in Kypseli
overview: 92 m2 third-floor apartment in Kypseli, the gentrification story of central Athens - prices still 40-50% below Koukaki with the strongest rent growth in the city. Needs a EUR 25-30k renovation (already reflected in the analysis price).
highlights: Lowest price per m2 in central Athens
Renovation upside baked into entry price
Large units rent fast to families/sharers

short_let.note: Kypseli (District 6) is outside the central-Athens AMA registration freeze.

title: Seafront 2-bed in Glyfada, Athens Riviera
overview: 75 m2 apartment 400 m from the Glyfada marina, in the path of the Ellinikon mega-project which is re-rating the whole southern coast. Lower yield, strongest capital-appreciation thesis of the Athens set.
risks: Yield compression - this is an appreciation play
Note: Golden Visa in Attica now requires EUR 800k single asset, this does not qualify

short_let.note: Strong summer season on the Riviera; winter occupancy soft. Glyfada is outside the central-Athens freeze.

title: Restored 2-bed in Palermo historic centre (Kalsa)
overview: 70 m2 restored apartment in La Kalsa, Palermo's old town, 5 min from the marina. Palermo offers the lowest entry prices of any major Italian city and rising tourist and student demand. Cedolare secca keeps rental taxation flat and simple.
highlights: Italy CGT-free after 5 years of ownership
risks: Palermo short-let registration (CIN code) now mandatory

short_let.note: Apr-Oct season carries the year. CIN registration code required.

title: 3-bed near University of Catania
overview: 95 m2 apartment between Piazza Universita and Via Etnea. Catania is Sicily's economic engine (ST Microelectronics expansion, 'Etna Valley' tech cluster) with reliable student and young-professional rental demand year round.
risks: Slower resale market than Palermo centre

short_let.note: Less touristy than Palermo; steadier from university/business visitors. CIN required.

title: 1-bed on Ortigia island, Syracuse
overview: 55 m2 apartment on Ortigia, the baroque island heart of Syracuse and Sicily's premium short-let market. Highest nightly rates on the island outside Taormina; modelled here conservatively as a long let.
highlights: Short-let upside over modelled long-let rent
risks: Seasonality if run as short let

short_let.note: Premium short-let market; highest nightly rates outside Taormina. CIN required.
